President Bola Tinubu arrived in Lagos on Saturday afternoon after attending the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, Oyo State, where he presented the party’s governorship candidates in the South-West, including Lagos Deputy Governor Obafemi Hamzat, to thousands of supporters.
According to a statement by Bayo Onanuga, the president’s Special Adviser on Information and Strategy, Mr Tinubu’s aircraft landed at the Presidential Wing of the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Ikeja, at about 3 p.m.
The president was received by Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu, Ogun State Governor Dapo Abiodun, the president’s Chief of Staff, Femi Gbajabiamila, former Ogun Governor Olusegun Osoba, and other government officials, APC leaders, and supporters.
“While in Lagos on the short visit, President Tinubu is scheduled to attend a special prayer session organised in his honour by members of his family on Sunday, November 22,” the statement read.
His arrival followed the APC rally at Mapo Hall in Ibadan, where he publicly presented Sharafadeen Alli, the Oyo South senator, as the party’s governorship candidate in Oyo State; Solomon Adeola, Ogun West senator, as the party’s governorship candidate in Ogun State; and Mr Hamzat, its candidate in Lagos.
The president raised the hands of the three candidates during the rally, signalling the party’s support for their respective governorship bids ahead of the 2027 elections.
The Oyo governorship contest is particularly significant for the APC as it seeks to wrest control of the state from Governor Seyi Makinde, who is also contesting the 2027 presidential election under the Allied Peoples Movement (APM).

Mr Tinubu’s visit also comes ahead of the APC’s planned presidential campaign rally in Lagos. The party’s revised campaign timetable lists the Lagos rally for 13 January 2027, following a change to the earlier schedule.
The president began his re-election campaign in Kaduna on 24 October. The Ibadan rally was his seventh appearance at a state rally since the campaign commenced.
Mr Tinubu will be contesting against 17 other candidates, including Mr Makinde.
